text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Approaching the final stretch!!
Every runner bursts into a sprint simultaneously!

text_block_list.name: Race Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Go, Mejiro Bright, gooo!!!"
"Stegooo!! Do your best!!!"
"Win it, Matikanefukukitaru!!!"

text_block_list.name: Bright & Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
—Yaaaaaah!!!
—Funnyaaaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Haha...!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, I see...
So that was it――)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: (I just wanted to throw it all at them.)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
(My potential...
To you all, who have become the aurora—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Haa... Haa... Haa...――

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Hahaha... hahahaha...!

Stego-saaaan!!
Lady Stego~.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Bright... Fukukitaru...――

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
We totally did it, didn't we!!
Didn't we just run an unbelievable race!?
I'm just completely overflowing with happiness!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu—... I also feel that
it was truly a race to be proud of
with our heads held high~.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Happy and proud, huh...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: (...Well, that's my line.)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: (That you were my classmates... shining so brilliantly as wonderful stayers.)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
(Being able to gather together like this today,
and compete in peak condition—)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Feels like one of my dreams has come true.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Stay Gold brilliantly demonstrated her full potential as a stayer in the Tenno Sho (Spring)—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: —Running alongside them made me realize something.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...Out of all of us,
who was truly the strongest stayer?"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"If only I could confirm that――
……Just kidding."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
That I harbored such "what-if" feelings...
toward that "memory."
choice_data_list: ...I want to keep discovering that together in the future.
...I hope we can keep discovering that going forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If I can make that 'what if' come true,
both at the Takarazuka Kinen and in the races after that—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was truly a journey filled with dreams.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
A journey filled with dreams that grants "what-ifs"... huh.
Ha-ha, I see—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...I wonder what kind of 'what-ifs'
we'll discover at the 'Takarazuka Kinen'."
choice_data_list: I'm really looking forward to it.
I'm really looking forward to it, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
It's bound to be another exciting race—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ――The wind blows.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Carrying dreams, conveying feelings, gathering bonds,
and weaving them together—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What will be spun is a world that no one has ever seen before.
*pant, pant, pant, pant*—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
ââPhew!
Time for a quick break...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...I can't wait.
Suzuka-san will be making her comeback soon, too—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The race with Grass-chan and the others too...
Opera O-san and the rest are working hard as well...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: This year's Twinkle Series is bound to be incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: All righty, I'm gonna push myself even harder--!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, Opera O-san...?
Is something wrong...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: —...It's a miracle.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...Just how long has it been like this?
Ever since I stepped onto the stage?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps, the moment the stage itself was born?
...Ah, but that is a trivial matter—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now is the time for rejoicing! The curtain rises!
It has begun! Nothing else matters!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Like the prelude to "Carmen"!
Like the overture to "The Marriage of Figaro"!!
The world begins to move vividly!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Doto! Are you prepared to run alongside me!?
Through this age of miracles and turbulent storms!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, I do...! 
As long as I'm with you, Opera O-san,
I can run anywhere...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
No matter what race, no matter how stormy,
I-I'm not scared...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, that's the spirit, Doto!
You are an indispensable part of this miraculous moment as well!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ――Dawn is breaking.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Brilliance transcends logic, gathering along the journey—
